claim_scope: For every integer \(n\geq4\), the largest non-overlapping binary length-\(n\) code with exactly three ones in each word has cardinality \(\lfloor (n-1)(n-2)/6\rfloor\).
integrity: The theorem is supported by an all-n mathematical proof; direct finite reproducibility checks through n=40, plus exhaustive primitive necklace comparison through n=25, are supplementary and do not certify infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: No conclusion for other Hamming weights, nonbinary compositions, unrestricted maximum size, or error correction. An unindexed earlier equivalent remains possible.
title: Sharp constant-weight-three non-overlapping binary codes at every length
